title: Clinical Data Analysis Platform
subtitle: An integrated workspace from data upload to publication-ready reports
description: Designed for medical researchers: upload cohort data, automate quality checks, preprocessing, and multi-model comparison, then generate clinical research reports that follow journal conventions.
qualityText: Column profiles and issue lists are generated on upload; analysis remains blocked until blocking issues are resolved
modelsText: Run 17 models in parallel, including logistic regression, random forests, and survival analysis, with metrics from a single source
reportsText: IMRaD structure, structured abstracts, and consistent tables and figures, with HTML / PDF export
cardSubtitle: Use your registered email to enter your research workspace
